title: GST Compliance and Returns in India
summary: GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B filing, purchase reconciliation with GSTR-2B, input credit tracking and notice support.
metaTitle: GST Return Filing and Compliance Services in India
metaDescription: GST compliance for Indian businesses: GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B filing, GSTR-2B reconciliation, input tax credit tracking, e-invoicing and notice support.
heroIntro: Where you are registered under GST, we prepare and file your returns on time, reconcile credits and keep your GST position tied to your books.
overview: GST is a monthly discipline: sales data, purchase data and credits all have to agree before you file. We make that part of your month-end close, so returns are prepared from reconciled books and filed before the due date, rather than assembled in a hurry.
whatWeDo: Prepare and file GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B before each due date.
Reconcile purchases with GSTR-2B and flag mismatches and ineligible credits.
Track input tax credit, reversals and reverse charge liabilities.
Support e-invoicing and e-way bill workflows.
Prepare the annual return and reconciliation where applicable.
Prepare data and draft responses for GST notices.
whoFor: Businesses registered under GST that want returns filed on time without chasing.
Companies with multiple GST registrations across states.
Exporters, e-commerce sellers and service businesses with complex invoicing.

byPlan.growth: Adds a quarterly GST health review.
byPlan.cfo: Adds GST impact review on new products and contracts.

note: Extra GST registrations add filings, so they are priced per registration as an add-on module.

faqs.q: What GST returns do you file?
faqs.a: GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B for regular taxpayers, plus the annual return and reconciliation where applicable, scoped to your registrations at onboarding.

faqs.q: How do you handle input tax credit mismatches?
faqs.a: Each month we reconcile your purchase ledger with GSTR-2B, flag missing or ineligible credits and follow up with suppliers through you.

faqs.q: Can you help with a GST notice?
faqs.a: We prepare data and draft responses for GST notices. Matters that are legally reserved for a licensed practitioner are handled by your appointed professional.
